|  | $Y=2$ | $Y=4$ | $Y=6$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $X=1$ | $0.1$ | $0.25$ | $0.25$ |
| $X=2$ | $0.05$ | $0.15$ | $0.2$ |

Compute $P(X=2\,\,\text{and}\,\,Y\le 4)$ given that the random variables $X$ and $Y$ have the joint probability mass function $f(x,y)$ shown in the table above.
questions.worked_solution:
Using the values in the table, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X=2\,\,\text{and}\,\,Y\le 4) & =P((X,Y)\in \{(2,2),(2,4)\}) \\  & =P((X,Y)=(2,2))+P((X,Y)=(2,4)) \\  & =f(2,2)+f(2,4) \\  & =0.05+0.15 \\  & =0.2.\end{aligned}
$$

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $X=0$ | $0.15$ | $0.25$ | $0.05$ |
| $X=1$ | $0.2$ | $0.12$ | $0.23$ |

Calculate $P(X+Y=1)$ given that the random variables $X$ and $Y$ have the joint probability mass function $f(x,y)$ shown in the table above.
questions.worked_solution:
Using the values in the table, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X+Y=1) & =P(X=0,Y=1)+P(X=1,Y=0) \\  & =f(0,1)+f(1,0) \\  & =0.25+0.2 \\  & =0.45.\end{aligned}
$$
